tip.en: Within the first 20 seconds you hit a -25% grade with HR still in the low 100s — a useful free-speed moment, but notice how quickly the terrain reverses and starts billing you back uphill. Use it to find rhythm, not to accelerate.
tip.zh: 开跑20秒内坡度即达-25%，心率仍在低位100左右，可借助重力找节奏，但注意地形随即反转上坡，不要借势压速。

tip.en: Only 46 seconds in and you're back up a 23% grade — the terrain is oscillating sharply in a tiny area. This local topography inflates effort perception early; your avg HR for this run ends up 10 bpm below recent history, partly because this initial spike burns fast and doesn't compound.
tip.zh: 仅46秒已遇到23%坡度的反向上坡，小范围内地形剧烈震荡，早期努力感知被放大；但本次平均心率比近期低10bpm，说明这段短暂刺激不会长期累积负担。

tip.en: Between idx 112 and 178 — roughly seconds 112–178 — pace collapses to 15–19 min/km and HR spikes to 143 despite near-zero movement, suggesting a traffic or signal stop. HR is still building through the standstill; when you resume, it drops sharply from 136 to 125, confirming the pause was passive recovery you didn't choose.
tip.zh: 约112至178秒间配速降至15-19分钟/公里，心率却升至143，提示被动等待（红灯或行人交通）。重新起跑后心率迅速从136降至125，说明这段停顿是非主动恢复。

title.zh: 峰值心率时的28%短坡冲刺

tip.en: A 28% uphill pitch at second 283 — coinciding with run-peak HR of 157–158 — fires immediately after the steepest downhill on the route. The sharp grade reversal in under 10 meters is the most mechanically demanding transition of the entire run; quad demand shifts from braking to explosive push-off instantaneously.
tip.zh: 第283秒28%上坡紧接在全程最陡下坡之后，心率同时触达峰值158。不足10米内坡度完全反转，股四头肌从制动瞬间切换为爆发发力，是本次跑最高机械应力时刻。

tip.en: HR drops from 157 to 141 in just two data points (seconds 291–293) as the steep downhill eases — a 16-bpm plunge that shows how heavily the cardio load was terrain-driven rather than pace-driven. Your true aerobic floor here is revealed as much lower than the peak implied.
tip.zh: 陡坡结束后心率在两个数据点内从157骤降至141，降幅16bpm，表明心脏负荷主要由地形驱动而非配速，真实有氧基础显著低于峰值所示。

title.en: Cardiac Drift Begins on the Long Grind

tip.en: From ~km 1.0 onward the route settles into a sustained 3–4% grade and HR climbs steadily from 134 to 151 over roughly 250 seconds while pace holds at 6:40–7:00 min/km. This is classic cardiac drift on a mild but unrelenting incline — the kind that inflates avg HR on hilly warmup routes versus your recent flat runs.
tip.zh: 约1公里后进入持续3-4%缓坡，250秒内心率从134稳步升至151，配速维持在6:40-7:00。这是典型的缓坡心率漂移，会系统性地抬高丘陵热身路线的平均心率，与近期平路跑有所不同。

title.en: Sustained 6–7% Effort — Your Actual Aerobic Work
title.zh: 持续6-7%坡度——本次真正的有氧刺激段

tip.en: From ~km 1.9 to 2.2 (seconds 787–895) you hold a 6–7% grade for over 100 seconds at HR 143–155 and pace ~7:00–8:30. This is the most productive aerobic segment of the run — longer and more consistent than anything earlier. For a declared warmup, this is doing real work; factor it into your pre-race fatigue accounting.
tip.zh: 约1.9至2.2公里段持续100余秒保持6-7%坡度，心率143-155，配速约7:00-8:30，是本次最有效的有氧刺激段。作为热身跑，这段已产生实质性训练负荷，赛前疲劳管理中需将其计入。

tip.en: The highest point (83.7 m at idx 916) is immediately followed by an -11% drop that cuts HR from 152 to 148 within four seconds. The transition is abrupt enough that your legs will need active attention to avoid overstriding on the descent — something that matters more if this terrain repeats in a race context.
tip.zh: 全程最高点83.7米后立即转入-11%下坡，心率四秒内从152降至148。反转节奏过急，下坡时需主动控制步幅避免过度前伸，若此地形在比赛中重复出现尤需注意。

title.zh: 第二圈楼梯式重复地形

tip.en: The telemetry shows the same micro-loop terrain cycling again from km 2.4–2.6, with another 9–10% climb segment and HR re-climbing to 139 from a post-descent low of 132. You are accumulating more load than a typical warmup label suggests — across 8 recent runs averaging 35 m of gain, this run's 88 m is an outlier.
tip.zh: 2.4-2.6公里段再次出现9-10%上坡，心率从下坡后低点132重新升至139。累积负荷远超普通热身水平——近8次跑平均爬升仅35米，本次88米明显偏高。

title.en: Third Interruption — Pattern of Stop-Start Terrain
title.zh: 第三次停顿——走走停停的地形模式

tip.en: Pace slows to 9–28 min/km from seconds 1209–1217 with HR flat at 143, the third noticeable pause on the run. The repeated stop-start pattern across this route prevents true warmup rhythm; your cardiovascular system never settles into the steady low-stress state a pre-race warmup ideally targets.
tip.zh: 1209-1217秒配速再次降至9-28分钟/公里，心率维持143不变，是本次第三次明显停顿。反复走走停停使心血管系统无法进入赛前热身理想的稳定低应激状态。

title.en: Late-Run Climb with HR Still Responding
title.zh: 跑程后段上坡心率仍有响应

tip.en: At km 3.1, over 20 minutes into the run, you tackle an 11% grade and HR climbs from 133 to 139 — still reactive. This tells you cardiac reserve is intact this late in the warmup, which is a useful positive signal heading into harder efforts.
tip.zh: 3.1公里处跑进20分钟后仍攻克11%坡度，心率从133升至139，表明心脏储备在热身后期依然充足，这是进入更高强度训练前的积极信号。

title.en: Long Descent Back to Base — Steady Shed
title.zh: 长段下坡回归低点——稳定释放

tip.en: From km 3.7 to 3.8 (seconds 1577–1597) a sustained -12 to -13% drop lasting ~20 seconds walks HR back from 147 to 143 smoothly. Unlike the earlier jagged reversals, this is a clean deload; use the grade to relax the hip flexors and reset contact time before the flat finish.
tip.zh: 3.7至3.8公里段持续约20秒的-12至-13%下坡，心率从147平稳降至143。与前段锯齿式起伏不同，这是一次干净的减负，可借此放松髋屈肌并重置落地节奏，为平路收尾做准备。
